report: Read all 14 verses end to end against the candidate table. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own rendering: לִי → against (41.5, 'against me') vs unrepresented (41.7, dative recast as the possessive 'my hurt', rule 40 with the suffix taking 'my'); לְ before an infinitive → to (41.6) vs unrepresented (41.8, 'rise up no more' writes no to, rule 52); בִּי → in (41.11 'delightest in me') vs unrepresented (41.12 'upholdest me', rule 40); לֹא → no (41.8, 'no more') vs not (41.11); עַל against/over; articles taking a written the (41.0, 41.2) vs none written (41.13). No construction is analysed two ways with nothing in the source to license it.

The added units were checked against each other since the table cannot see them: 'saying' (41.5), 'me' and 'it' and 'When' (41.6), 'say they' (41.8), 'his' (41.9), 'as for' (41.12) are each English no morpheme owns, and none is folded into a neighbour elsewhere in the chapter. The one arguable case is 41.5 'saying', which could be read as a second realization of יֹאמְרוּ in one discontinuous unit; the verse pass took added and named the alternative, and neither reading is clearly preferable, so it stands.

Contested placements the verse passes flagged were re-read and hold: 41.8 'now that' on אֲשֶׁר as one rendering (rule 30) with 'he shall … more' on יוֹסִיף under rule 56's auxiliary-verb sentence, matching לֹא אֹסִיף → 'will I any more'; 41.12 לְפָנֶיךָ split into before / face / thy because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme (rule 30's 'to meet' shape); 41.6 לַחוּץ → abroad fused with preposition and assimilated article (rule 30), the only 3-morpheme unit.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences, none an error: the five R tokens (אֶל 41.1, לִי 41.7, לָ 41.8, לָהֶם 41.10, בִּי 41.12) are prepositions the ASV's recasting leaves wordless under rule 40/52; 41.4 paragogic he (Sh) is rule 32; 41.9 resumptive בוֹ suffix beside a separately written 'in whom' is rule 22; the two articles of 41.13 מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם have no the written (rule 29).

No convention recorded: every repeated note restates a contract rule, and the chapter's special renderings (cleaveth fast, now that, Chief Musician) are verse-local. Nothing here generalises beyond what rules 40, 44, 52 and 56 already say, so no promotion or amendment.
